# Taipreneur Agency

> Full-service digital agency in Bangalore, India. We build websites, run digital marketing, automate lead follow-up with AI, and improve visibility on Google and in AI assistants through SEO, GEO and AEO. Sectors: colleges and real estate. Pricing is by quote.

## Services
- [Website Development](https://taipreneur.com/website-development): fast, mobile-first websites, e-commerce and apps
- [Digital Marketing](https://taipreneur.com/digital-marketing): Google, Meta and YouTube campaigns managed against cost per lead
- [AI Automation](https://taipreneur.com/ai-automation): lead capture, follow-up, CRM and reporting automation
- [SEO, GEO and AEO](https://taipreneur.com/seo-geo-aeo): search, AI-assistant and answer-engine visibility

## Sectors
- [Digital marketing for colleges](https://taipreneur.com/education-digital-marketing)
